history.summary: Famous Shiva temple in Jodhpur built by Nanak Devi, queen of Rao Ganga (the Rathore ruler of Marwar), with construction completed on 21 May 1531. Built of carved Chhitar stone, its halls include the Garbh Griha (housing the Shivling), Mandap Bhawan and Kirtan Bhawan. A notable feature is the Ganga Bawari, a large water reservoir near the Shivling that served as a drinking-water tank and for ritual use. The temple stands in Sodagaran Mohalla in Jodhpur city.

name: Achal Nath Shivalaya
town_description: Jodhpur, the Blue City, is the second-largest city of Rajasthan and the historic capital of Marwar - home to Mehrangarh Fort and many old temples, with an airport and major rail junction.

travel.road: At Sodagaran Mohalla in Jodhpur city; reachable by city bus or taxi.
